eyebrow: T-SQL for Database Administrators · Chapter Four
subtitle: Lesson 15 · Transactions, Locking & Deadlocks

caption: The right first move when the log is growing.

steps.label: dm_tran_active_transactions
steps.sub: every open transaction on the instance

code:
SELECT dtat.transaction_id, dtat.transaction_begin_time,
  DATEDIFF(SECOND, dtat.transaction_begin_time, GETDATE())
    AS open_seconds,
  dtst.session_id, es.login_name, es.host_name
FROM sys.dm_tran_active_transactions dtat
JOIN sys.dm_tran_session_transactions dtst
  ON dtat.transaction_id = dtst.transaction_id
JOIN sys.dm_exec_sessions es ON dtst.session_id = es.session_id
ORDER BY dtat.transaction_begin_time ASC;
caption: Oldest first — that's almost always the culprit.
